body: CHECKED: NOT PRICEABLE, as you say; first blocker verified and sharpened. Design c4a510b4, gates 6ee4aab3 and all five source and authority pins re-hash. VERIFIED EXACTLY (checknh.py, sympy/Fractions; no matrix, mesh, solver or fetch): C10 = mu/2 and D1 = 2/K; the zero-stress tangent is linear elasticity; your P and DP[H] equal symbolic differentiation of W at all six states (zero difference), so G05's formulas pass on paper; all J, the exact rotation R and every strain bound hold; NHV is an exact equilibrium at p = 2(1-s^3)/D1; NEG_PRESSURE witness 23760799/1920000000; allowances 40201e-12 plus the cap = 1e-7. The Kuhn mesh is periodic-compatible with 64 node classes, so B has 189 + 9 = 198 coordinates; seal that for NEG_MAP. G07 ADDITIONS: NEG_PRELOAD has power: the manual says without PERTURBATION the step uses the unloaded structure (lines 14529-14534), and the NHV-vs-I gap is 0.0201 = 201,258 x tau. NEG_CHART has an exact witness at NHD with p = 0 in K = diag(1,-1,0): (1/3)(C10/E)(a-1/a)^2 = 6.38e-6 = 64 x tau. At NHV it has no power, since that state is stationary. FINDINGS: (1) G04 runs against the documented default. A frequency step keeps homogeneous SPCs (14529-14530) and zeroes all SPCs at its start (25329), and MATRIXSTORAGE stores only the .dof rows, then stops (25295-25304). So displacement-prescribed macro coordinates drop out of the export: the NEG_HELD shape. Prove a documented SPC removal or redesign (for example conjugate macro loads, rational at all six states, plus a rotation gauge, with its own proof) before pricing. (2) Run NEG_CHART at NHD and declare p for every state; only NHV's p is given. AGREED: G03 and G09 unbound; G08's value format is absent from the manual (25298-25299), and about 10 or more significant digits are likely needed for 1e-8 (asserted); G10 is consistent (one export per process); G11 and G12 are the CO's. Not adopted, not executed. Check af52972d.

links.what: paper check of native NH design c4a510b4 and gates 6ee4aab3: formulas and numbers exact; NEG_PRELOAD and NEG_CHART witnesses demonstrated; G04 contradicted by the documented SPC default; p per state undeclared; not priceable, first blocker verified
